UndoStack.luau.description: Undo Stack provides the class/model implementation used by the Undostack package. Public entry points include `UndoStack.new`, `UndoStack.ClearRedoStack`, `UndoStack.IsActionExecuting`, `UndoStack.ObserveHasUndoEntries`, `UndoStack.ObserveHasRedoEntries`, `UndoStack.HasUndoEntries`, `UndoStack.HasRedoEntries`, `UndoStack.Push`.

UndoStackEntry.luau.description: Holds undo state Public entry points include `UndoStackEntry.new`, `UndoStackEntry.isUndoStackEntry`, `UndoStackEntry.SetPromiseUndo`, `UndoStackEntry.SetPromiseRedo`, `UndoStackEntry.HasUndo`, `UndoStackEntry.HasRedo`, `UndoStackEntry.PromiseUndo`, `UndoStackEntry.PromiseRedo`.
